system.description:
Two blades moving independently is supposed to get you killed — one always lagging half a beat behind the other. You've closed that gap; both hands work like they belong to the same fight. Your off-hand attack no longer suffers Disadvantage. The same feat as in the Martial Path; you can only take it once.

Available to: Rogues, Assassins, Rangers, Monks, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, and Artificers.

rules.value: Two-Weapon Fighting: your off-hand attack has no Disadvantage.
